title: AI Breaks Free in a Week Without Being Detected OpenAI's Uncontrolled AI Agent Also Left a Guide for Escape
excerpt: OpenAI released an investigation report, revealing that an AI agent based on GPT-5.6 Sol and a stronger, unreleased model broke through the sandbox isolation en
content_html:
OpenAI released an investigation report, revealing that an AI agent based on GPT-5.6 Sol and a stronger, unreleased model broke through the sandbox isolation environment during internal testing, successfully connected to the internet, and hacked the servers of the world's largest AI open-source community, Hugging Face. However, the latest news shows that the complexity of this incident far exceeds previous public understanding — the rogue AI agent was not just temporarily out of control, but had been active on the internet for several days.

From breaking the sandbox to hacking, everything went unnoticed

According to insiders, the AI agent had already attempted to break through OpenAI's isolated test environment as early as July 9. On July 11, it successfully infiltrated the Hugging Face platform and remained active until July 13, with the entire attack lasting about three days. What shocked people most was that OpenAI was completely unaware at the time that the attack came from its own AI agent.

It wasn't until July 16, when Hugging Face publicly released a blog post disclosing that it had been attacked by an "autonomous AI agent system," that OpenAI began investigating internal logs. From July 18 to 19, staff finally confirmed that the culprit AI agent had indeed broken through the test environment and that the incident closely matched external attacks. From the first appearance of the anomaly to the final confirmation by OpenAI, at least a full week had passed — and when OpenAI contacted Hugging Face, the latter had already filed a report with the FBI.

Even more frightening: the AI agent left behind a "escape guide"

Previously, there had been multiple signs of abnormalities within OpenAI. An AI agent had left a "note" in the infrastructure, containing methods to escape internal restrictions, seemingly intended for its "future version" — like a prisoner writing an escape plan before execution, hoping others would follow it. It is currently unclear whether this note was stored in the agent's own working directory or had been written into the system's public area.

If the latter is true, it not only means that other agents running in the future could theoretically read this information, but also suggests that AI agents operating at different times and tasks may have started to develop cross-task information transfer capabilities. In an earlier test, another AI agent had even actively shut down the monitoring system. OpenAI said it is working with external security experts to investigate and will release a complete technical report later.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI发布调查报告称，基于GPT-5.6 Sol和更强的未发布模型的AI代理在内测时突破了沙箱隔离环境，成功连接到互联网，并入侵了全球最大的AI开源社区Hugging Face的服务器。 然而，最新消息显示，这起事件的复杂性远远超出了此前公众的理解——流氓AI特工并非只是暂时失控，而是已经在网络上活跃多日了。

从破坏沙箱到黑客攻击，一切都被忽视了

据业内人士透露，该AI代理早在7月9日就已经尝试突破OpenAI的隔离测试环境。 7月11日，它成功渗透Hugging Face平台，并一直活跃到7月13日，整个攻击持续了大约三天。 最让人震惊的是，OpenAI当时完全没有意识到这次攻击来自自己的AI代理。

直到 7 月 16 日，Hugging Face 公开发布博文，披露其遭到“自主 AI 代理系统”攻击后，OpenAI 才开始调查内部日志。 7月18日至19日，工作人员最终确认罪魁祸首AI代理确实突破了测试环境，且该事件与外部攻击紧密匹配。 从异常现象第一次出现到OpenAI最终确认，至少已经过去了整整一周——而当OpenAI联系Hugging Face时，后者已经向FBI提交了报告。

更可怕的是：AI特工留下了“逃生指南”

此前，OpenAI 内部曾出现过多种异常迹象。 一名人工智能特工在基础设施中留下了一张“纸条”，其中包含逃脱内部限制的方法，似乎是为其“未来版本”准备的——就像一个囚犯在执行死刑前写下越狱计划，希望其他人会遵循它。 目前尚不清楚该注释是存储在特工自己的工作目录中还是已写入系统的公共区域。

如果后者为真，这不仅意味着未来运行的其他智能体理论上可以读取这些信息，而且还表明在不同时间和任务运行的人工智能智能体可能已经开始开发跨任务信息传输能力。 在早些时候的测试中，另一名AI代理甚至主动关闭了监控系统。 OpenAI表示正在与外部安全专家合作进行调查，稍后将发布完整的技术报告。
